captions.gbp:
Easy from check-in to results: here's what patients shared in their Google reviews.

"From the moment I arrived, the staff was friendly, professional, and made the entire process easy and stress-free. The check-in was efficient, and the technicians took the time to explain everything clearly…" (Gabriella E.)

"The experience was fast, professional, and friendly. The front desk, Joy checked in quick and the technician's name was Lisa and she did a great job." (James W.)

"Friendly, prompt service. Convenient location & quick turnaround with results." (Gavin H.)

Need a scan? An easy one should come with a price you know before you go, a quick answer on your request, a short wait at check-in and a report your doctor can see. At AMI, self-pay MRI is $295 with the radiologist reading included. Paying self-pay? No referral is needed, our physician reviews your request the same day, and same-day appointments are often available. We accept insurance too. Seminole and St. Pete.

Book online at advancedimg.com. Individual experiences vary. General information, not medical advice.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-11-09 on amiweb main (cf6e4d6): prices.ts mri $295 (radiologist reading always included); services/no-referral-mri (self-pay needs no referral, physician reviews request the same day, same-day appointments often available for self-pay). No clinical claims in this post.
